primary.scope: Six fixed banks and one frozen tie stream per bank; approximate seed-cluster uncertainty.

search_reuse_mapping.rule: Same support bytes and seed; B0, unit1, tau0, ebar0 and all other settings fixed by protocol.

limitations: Active acquisition is simulated from stored complete boards; the policy itself sees only queried labels.
25 queries per board fixes label cost. Policies can expose different digits from the same current row, then learn from their different histories.
Adaptive masks are not independent uniform draws, so the previous independent-mask coverage theorem does not directly apply.
BP AdamW is outside this count-energy acquisition mechanism study and is not run.
Only six fixed complete-board banks and one fixed tie stream per bank. Bootstrap over bank clusters is approximate and does not establish population-wide acquisition guarantees.
The graph-coverage target is the registered primary. Secondary accuracy intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
Correct returned best boards may have positive energy; zero-energy oracle fractions bound correct certified stops only.
